content_zh:
第一卷：风起时第一百零八章：黑月吞人
“谁让你走了？”
陈风奇声音平静，却带着莫名的压力。
本想转身离开的洪文治，在听到这句话后，脚步顿了顿，冷笑道：“我想走就走，你又能拿我怎样？”
话落，他继续转身而去，打算先远离这个玄月异象的范围。
可就在此时，陈风奇动了。
只见他抬手，对准了洪文治，遥遥一抓。
顿时，有一股恐怖的重力，自陈风奇的掌心蔓延出去，作用在了洪文治的身上，形成了牵扯。
在这股重力的牵扯下，洪文治竟然不受控制，被猛地拉拽着朝陈风奇靠近。
仿佛在陈风奇的掌心，有着一根无形的重力绳索，正死死拉拽着洪文治。
这就是陈风奇的第二则神通，玄月。
此神通，以重力异术为基础，却又因为加入了“月”的元素，使之变得更为神异。
若将视界放到陈风奇的体内，可见他的第二盏神照灯，正神光璀璨，在灯火之中，映照着一轮漆黑玄月。
以往在施展重力异术时，陈风奇最多就是能做到让一片区域覆盖重压。
可如今，在转化为神通后，神照灯中的玄月，仿佛就成了一个重力的源头，使得陈风奇能完全掌控玄月重力，做到许多以往做不到的事情。
恰如此刻，他甚至能掌控一股重力，宛如将之拧成绳索，精确作用在洪文治一人身上，使之一人承受重力牵引，而不会影响周围环境。
这一点，就是以往的他，万万做不到的。
洪文治心中大惊，立刻就要运转修为，去斩断那种重力牵引。
可忽然间，一股更加惊人的重力牵引，出现了。
即便是陈风奇，也因为这突然出现的另一股重力牵引，而感到惊讶。

至于洪文治，就完全是惊恐了，猛地抬头看去。
只见，头顶上方的那一轮漆黑玄月，旋转的速度已经越来越快，逐渐宛如一个漆黑漩涡。
而玄月洒下的月光，就如同方才陈风奇施展神通一样，化作了重力绳索，牵引着周围的一切，疯狂朝着玄月中拉拽。
这一刻，那玄月异象，就如同化作了一个恐怖的重力源头。
甚至给洪文治的感觉，那仿佛就是一个黑洞，有着极其恐怖的引力，欲要将周围的一切都吞噬进去。
或许玄月还远无法与真正的黑洞相比，但此刻在洪文治的心中，就是这种感觉。
他已经将修为运转到了极致，想要挣脱玄月异象的牵引，离开这里。
可随着那玄月旋转的速度越来越快，形成的重力牵引也越来越强，竟让他一时之间无法远离，速度完全提不上去，好似蜗牛爬行。
陈风奇已经收回手，蹙眉看着上方疯狂旋转的玄月异象。
无需他再出手，上方的玄月异象，就够洪文治喝一壶的了。
甚至连陈风奇自己，也能感受到那股重力牵引，就仿佛是玄月异象洒下的一缕缕漆黑月光，正在不断拉拽着他，要将他吞入月中。
不过因为陈风奇有玄月神通，能轻易掌控周身的重力，使得那些漆黑月光对他形成的重力牵扯微乎其微，根本拉拽不动他。
此刻他已经意识到，上方的那一轮黑月，应该就是自己点燃神照灯时，意外引动的天地异象。
虽然不知道为什么会这样，现在的他连神照异象都还不清楚。
包括上一次，在点燃第一盏神照灯，映照出寒月神通时，海面上曾出现过的那轮寒月异象，他甚至完全不知道。
所以，对于李太子和暗星被冰封在寒月之中，又被蛟龙一尾巴拍飞的事，他同样完全不知。
他只知道，此刻自己头顶上方出现的黑月异象，很不简单。
当黑月旋转的速度越来越快，重力牵扯也越来越强。
从远处看，黑月异象所在的方圆千里，已经变成了一个巨大的黑色漩涡。
并且影响的范围还在越来越广，所有的漆黑月光，都成了漩涡的一部分，好似涡流。

陈风奇所在的整座岛屿，都被月光撕成了粉碎，旋转着被黑月吞噬。
乃至于，下方原本塌陷下去的海水，同样在月光的牵扯下开始升腾，也在被黑月疯狂吞噬。
唯有陈风奇，掌控着周身的重力，不受月光牵引，独自屹立在那里。
content_en:
Volume One: When the Wind Rises Chapter 108: The Black Moon Swallows People
"Who asked you to leave?"
Chen Fengqi's voice was calm, but filled with inexplicable pressure.
Hong Wenzhi, who wanted to turn around and leave, paused after hearing these words, and sneered: "I can leave whenever I want, what can you do to me?"
After saying this, he continued to turn around and leave, intending to stay away from the scope of this Xuan Yue phenomenon.
But at this moment, Chen Fengqi moved.
I saw him raising his hand, aiming at Hong Wenzhi, and grabbing him from a distance.
Suddenly, a terrifying gravity spread from Chen Fengqi's palm and acted on Hong Wenzhi, forming a pull.
Under the pull of this gravity, Hong Wenzhi lost control and was violently pulled towards Chen Fengqi.
It was as if there was an invisible gravity rope in Chen Fengqi's palm, pulling Hong Wenzhi tightly.
This is Chen Fengqi's second magical power, Xuan Yue.
This magical power is based on gravity magic, but it becomes even more magical because of the addition of the "moon" element.
If you put your vision into Chen Fengqi's body, you can see that his second divine lamp is shining brightly, and in the lamplight, it reflects a dark black moon.
In the past, when Chen Fengqi used gravity magic, the most he could do was to cover an area with heavy pressure.
But now, after being transformed into a magical power, the Xuan Yue in the divine lamp seems to have become a source of gravity, allowing Chen Fengqi to completely control the Xuan Yue's gravity and do many things that he could not do before.
At this moment, he could even control a force of gravity, as if twisting it into a rope, and precisely acting on Hong Wenzhi, allowing him to bear the pull of gravity without affecting the surrounding environment.
This is something he could never do in the past.
Hong Wenzhi was shocked and immediately started to use his cultivation to cut off the gravitational pull.
But suddenly, an even more astonishing pull of gravity appeared.
Even Chen Fengqi was surprised by the sudden appearance of another gravitational pull.
As for Hong Wenzhi, he was completely frightened and looked up suddenly.
I saw that the dark moon above my head was spinning faster and faster, gradually becoming like a dark whirlpool.
And the moonlight shed by Xuan Yue, just like Chen Fengqi's magical power just now, turned into a gravity rope, pulling everything around, pulling crazily towards Xuan Yue.
At this moment, the Xuan Yue phenomenon seemed to turn into a terrifying source of gravity.
It even felt to Hong Wenzhi that it was like a black hole, with extremely terrifying gravity, trying to swallow everything around it.
Maybe Xuan Yue is still far from being comparable to a real black hole, but this is the feeling in Hong Wenzhi's heart at this moment.
He has pushed his cultivation to the extreme and wants to break away from the pull of Xuan Yue's strange phenomenon and leave here.
But as the Xuan Yue rotated faster and faster, the gravitational pull formed became stronger and stronger, making it impossible for him to stay away for a while, unable to increase his speed at all, like a snail crawling.
Chen Fengqi had already retracted his hand, frowning and looking at the Xuan Yue phenomenon spinning crazily above him.
There was no need for him to take action anymore. The Xuan Yue vision above was enough for Hong Wenzhi to drink from a pot.
Even Chen Fengqi himself can feel the pull of gravity, as if the wisps of dark moonlight shed by the Xuan Yue phenomenon are constantly pulling him, trying to swallow him into the moon.
However, because Chen Fengqi has the mysterious power of the mysterious moon, he can easily control the gravity around him, so the gravity exerted by the dark moonlight on him is minimal and cannot pull him at all.
At this moment, he had realized that the black moon above should be the vision of heaven and earth that he accidentally triggered when he lit the magic lamp.
Although he doesn't know why this is happening, he still doesn't even know what the divine vision is.
Including the last time, when the first magical lamp was lit and the cold moon magical power was illuminated, the cold moon appeared on the sea.Elephant, he didn't even know it at all.
Therefore, he also had no idea about Prince Li and Dark Star being frozen in the cold moon and being slapped away by the dragon's tail.
He only knew that the black moon phenomenon appearing above his head at this moment was not simple.
As the Black Moon spins faster and faster, the pull of gravity becomes stronger and stronger.
Seen from a distance, the thousand-mile radius where the black moon phenomenon is located has turned into a huge black whirlpool.
And the scope of influence is getting wider and wider, and all the dark moonlight has become part of the vortex, like a vortex.
The entire island where Chen Fengqi was located was torn into pieces by the moonlight, spinning and swallowed by the black moon.
As a result, the seawater that originally collapsed below also began to rise under the influence of the moonlight, and was also being crazily devoured by the black moon.
Only Chen Fengqi controlled the gravity around him and stood there alone without being pulled by the moonlight.
